claims.assertion: Mari Swa claims US and Russian agencies have used trained astral travelers for remote viewing and developed astral guards for sensitive sites.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says these projects are highly classified.

claims.assertion: Mari says extraterrestrial agents and Federation factions also use astral travel, sometimes crossing paths with terrestrial intelligence operations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: This is her account of astral activity and intergroup conflict.

review_flags: The video presents unverified paranormal and intelligence claims as entertainment.
